long_biography.plain_text:
Before his investment work, Philippe Ligot helped steer Athem's Paris studio through large-scale visual productions. Its teams created facade projections and temporary settings for cultural institutions and luxury brands, while advertising helped finance the restoration of historic buildings. He served as its president and held an ownership interest as the studio developed its scenography business. In late 2023 it became part of The Independents, an international marketing group.

Ligot had placed substantial personally owned shares into Norman Capital, an investment holding he chaired. Its later accounts recorded sizable participations and distributions before the French company underwent a cross-border move to Luxembourg. He also founded Life Course Academy in Sardinia, bringing his long involvement in competitive sailing into an education programme. The academy represents a new project, distinct from the business holdings that established his financial position.
